name: Carolina Metal Fabricators
old_description: One of the most advanced fabrication companies on the East Coast that specializes in both structural and miscellaneous steel for the industrial sectors.  The technology we employ through both software and machinery allows us to get your fabrication delivered quickly to the job site with 100% accuracy.  We pride ourselves on being the fabricator of choice for all industrial segments along the East Coast.
about:
Carolina Metal Fabricators operates from Raleigh, North Carolina, providing structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication for industrial customers throughout the East Coast. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names in its public materials.

The shop specializes in plate fabrication and promotes a technology-driven approach that pairs advanced robotics—including a system referred to as the "Dragon"—with proprietary software to accelerate production and achieve high dimensional accuracy. Its facility is described as streamlined, staffed by experienced craftsmen, and capable of working with various alloys, though specific metrics such as floor space, employee count, or annual output are not provided.

The company markets its services broadly to industrial sectors, stating it serves all industrial segments along the East Coast. No specific industry verticals, project case studies, or named clients are cited in the available information.

Carolina Metal Fabricators asserts that its combination of software and machinery enables rapid job-site delivery with 100% accuracy, positioning this integration as its primary competitive distinction. The emphasis on robotic automation and digital workflow underpins its claim to be among the most advanced fabrication shops in the region.
